title: Momoi Airi — It Wasn't Enough〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Outside the MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm totally out of gas...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's dance practice was as hard as ever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm super hungry now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't we all go somewhere to eat?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds good. We've been practicing pretty hard for the grand prix, so it might be nice to relax for a change.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I need to go shop for some stuff today, so you three have fun without me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, let's go out to eat another time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll get a chance to soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What are you shopping for, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A present for my mom.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For your mom? Oh, is her birthday coming up or something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nothing like that, but...
Remember the story I told you all the other day about my first audition? She's been supporting me so much ever since then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was reminded how she's the reason I was able to become an idol at all. And I'm able to keep working as one because of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I want to show just how much I appreciate her by buying her a little gift.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so wonderful.
I'm sure your mother's going to love your gift.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have you already decided what you're going to get her?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not fully. I'm getting her a bouquet and something else. I still haven't decided what that's gonna be yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My plan for today is to browse around a few shops.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, can I go with you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your mother helped you become an idol, which means I also owe her quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That also goes for me.
I'd like to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, I think I'll take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can count on us! Let's go find a gift that really encapsulates your feelings, Airi!
Several dozen minutes later
General Store

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here we are. Let's start looking, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're looking for relaxation products, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. My mom leads a busy life, so I want to give her something that washes away fatigue.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Something that washes away fatigue...
Oh, they have some aroma diffusers over here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They even have a wide variety of essential oils available. If you buy several different kinds, she could change them out as she pleases.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “A quiet model that produces only fifteen decibels of noise”...? Not bad. She could put this in her bedroom.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we're going with something fragrant, then the bath salts over there could also work. I'm sure she enjoys having nice, relaxing baths.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go check them out!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting while I paid for it, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You went with that aroma diffuser, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The sample fragrances they had were amazing, so I have a feeling this will help her sleep really well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now we just need to head over to the flower shop for that bouquet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, before we do...
We found something nice while you were at the register.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is this a message card...?
Oh, it's covered in hearts! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Isn't it adorable?
This would make your bouquet for her feel even more special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And make it all the more clear just how much you appreciate her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll include this...
Thanks for the help, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (These three have helped turn my gift into something really lovely.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I hope Mom likes it...)
